info.description: The individual-based twin of the System dynamics library's Bass diffusion asset: 2000 Prospect agents, each moving from Potential to Adopter at the SHARED hazard p + q * Adopters/m (innovation p plus imitation q proportional to the fraction already adopted) -- no self term, so this is exactly the mean-field Bass rate applied per agent. With p=0.03, q=0.4, the SD closed form puts the inflection at t*=ln(q/p)/(p+q) and the adopted fraction there at (q-p)/(2q); the agent run matches it within Monte Carlo noise. p, q and the market size m are this instance's own; the Product preset fills p and q from an illustrative catalogue.
